scripts.wasm: cargo build -p scribyra-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/scribyra_app.wasm --target web --out-dir web/pkg
scripts.build: cargo build -p scribyra-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/scribyra_app.wasm --target web --remove-name-section --out-dir web/pkg && vite build
scripts.test: npm run wasm && cargo test -p scribyra-telemetry -p scribyra-core -p scribyra-assets -p scribyra-companion -p scribyra-folders -p scribyra-sync && cargo build -p scribyra-companion -p scribyra-folders -p scribyra-sync --bins --examples && node --test tests/replication.test.mjs tests/direct-off.test.mjs tests/direct-continuity.test.mjs tests/review-input.test.mjs tests/service.test.mjs tests/sync.test.mjs tests/tex-link.test.mjs tests/model.test.mjs tests/latex.test.mjs tests/storage.test.mjs tests/import-files.test.mjs tests/references.test.mjs tests/virtual-fs-guard.test.mjs tests/editor.test.mjs tests/source-map.test.mjs tests/commands.test.mjs tests/agent-commands.test.mjs tests/comments.test.mjs tests/reviews.test.mjs tests/history.test.mjs tests/integration-review.test.mjs tests/integration-random.test.mjs tests/tex-packages.test.mjs tests/build-session.test.mjs tests/environment.test.mjs tests/runtime-identity.test.mjs tests/runtime-assets.test.mjs tests/tex-metadata.test.mjs tests/dependencies.test.mjs tests/compatibility.test.mjs tests/catalog.test.mjs tests/tex-cache.test.mjs tests/downloads.test.mjs tests/diagnostics.test.mjs tests/biber-project.test.mjs tests/companion.test.mjs tests/providers.test.mjs tests/local-tabs.test.mjs tests/storage-upgrade.test.mjs tests/reconciliation.test.mjs tests/update-notice.test.mjs tests/compile-log.test.mjs tests/large-projects.test.mjs tests/delivery.test.mjs tests/telemetry*.test.mjs
scripts.test:companion: cargo build -p scribyra-companion --bins --examples && node --test tests/companion.test.mjs tests/providers.test.mjs
scripts.test:sync: cargo build -p scribyra-sync --examples --bins && node --test tests/sync.test.mjs tests/service.test.mjs
scripts.test:local-sync: npm run wasm && node --test tests/local-tabs.test.mjs tests/storage.test.mjs tests/storage-upgrade.test.mjs
scripts.test:folders: npm run wasm && cargo test -p scribyra-core -p scribyra-folders && cargo build -p scribyra-folders && node --test tests/reconciliation.test.mjs
scripts.test:ingestion: cargo build -p scribyra-telemetry --bins --examples --locked && python3 scripts/telemetry-tools.py alloy && playwright test tests/browser/telemetry-ingestion.spec.js
scripts.test:native-telemetry: cargo build -p scribyra-companion -p scribyra-folders -p scribyra-sync --bins --examples --locked && node --test tests/telemetry-native.test.mjs
scripts.test:ingestion:native: cargo build -p scribyra-companion -p scribyra-telemetry --bins --examples --locked && python3 scripts/telemetry-tools.py alloy && playwright test tests/browser/telemetry-native.spec.js
scripts.test:storage:native: cargo build -p scribyra-companion -p scribyra-folders -p scribyra-sync --bins --examples --locked && node --test tests/telemetry-native-storage.test.mjs && playwright test tests/browser/telemetry-native-storage.spec.js
